name: Workday Payroll Report
query:
SELECT
    w.`employee_name`,
    ROUND(SUM(w.`regular_hours`), 2) as 'regular_hours',
    ROUND(SUM(w.`overtime_hours`), 2) as 'overtime_hours',
    ROUND(SUM(w.`total_hours`), 2) as 'total_hours'
FROM
    (
        SELECT
            CONCAT(YEAR(`date`), '/', WEEK(`date`)) as `week`,
            `employee_name`,
            ROUND(LEAST(SUM(`total_hours`), 40), 2) as `regular_hours`,
            ROUND(GREATEST(SUM(`total_hours`) - 40, 0), 2) as `overtime_hours`,
            ROUND(SUM(`total_hours`), 2) as `total_hours`
        FROM
            `tabWorkday`
        WHERE
            `date` >= %(start_date)s
            AND `date` <= %(end_date)s
        GROUP BY
            `week`,
            `employee_name`
    ) w
GROUP BY
    w.`employee_name`
ORDER BY
    w.`employee_name`
